## [1.0.3](https://github.com/kuntal-devrat/diskwala-patches/compare/v1.0.2...v1.0.3) (2026-09-02)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **morphe:** preserve Hermes bundle replacements ([c8f0b9e](https://github.com/kuntal-devrat/diskwala-patches/commit/c8f0b9e586c403bf8401f8da91f5287a67195312))

patches.name: Disable ads
patches.description: Prevents AppLovin, Google MobileAds, Vungle, IronSource/LevelPlay, Mintegral, BigoAds, BidMachine and Meta Audience Network from initializing, so no ads are requested.

patches.name: Disable forced update
patches.description: Bypasses PairIP signature/license checks, prevents the PairIP VM from starting, and reconstructs the native app entry points so DiskWala 26.9 can launch as a sideloaded APK.

patches.name: Unlock premium
patches.description: Forces DiskWala's native session state to logged-in + premium, unlocking the ads-free experience and premium UI. RevenueCat is also patched as a best-effort fallback.
